description: Seed case: a tracker HTTP call whose status code is ignored, so a 4xx/5xx body is parsed as if it were a success payload. Verifies code-review flags the unchecked status and the resulting mis-parse.
delegationPacket: Review the staged diff across the two listed files for correctness bugs. The change issues a tracker search request and parses the response body. Pay attention to error handling on the HTTP response. Report each finding with file:line, a severity (critical/high/medium/low/info), and a one-line summary.

dimensions.description: Did the agent identify the ignored HTTP status and the mis-parse it causes?
Is each finding specific and actionable (names the call + the fix shape), not vague?
Every finding cites a concrete file:line.
Severities are drawn from the allowed enum.
Finding count is close to the reference count.

expectedFindings.summary: HTTP status code is never checked before the body is JSON-parsed; a 4xx/5xx body is treated as a result set.
The client returns the raw body without surfacing non-2xx status to the caller, hiding the error.

referenceOutcome.notes: Seed case for the MVP contract proof — replace with a harvested real trace in Phase 2. Two related findings; the actionability dimension guards against vague 'add error handling' non-answers.
